name: The Rolling Stones

whyMatters.en: London blues-rock band formed in 1962. Keith Richards’s riff writing, Mick Jagger’s vocals, and Charlie Watts’s drumming run from 1960s singles through the late-60s/early-70s albums and long-term touring.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦蓝调摇滚乐队，1962 年成立。Keith Richards 的 riff 写作、Mick Jagger 的人声与 Charlie Watts 的鼓，从 1960 年代单曲贯穿 60 末/70 初专辑与长期巡演。

note.en: Richards fuzz riff (Gibson Maestro FZ-1); US and UK #1 in 1965.
note.zh: Richards 的 fuzz riff（Gibson Maestro FZ-1）；1965 年英美榜冠军。

note.en: From Beggars Banquet; samba-style percussion and call-and-response vocals.
note.zh: 出自《Beggars Banquet》；桑巴式打击乐与呼应人声。

note.en: From Let It Bleed; Merry Clayton on guest vocals.
note.zh: 出自《Let It Bleed》；客串人声为 Merry Clayton。

interviewQuotes.text: It's only rock 'n' roll but I like it.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Mick Jagger

interviewQuotes.text: The music is the most important thing.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Keith Richards

lyricQuotes: Rape, murder, it's just a shot away

shortBio.en: London blues-rock, 1962–. Jagger/Richards writing; Satisfaction and the 1968–72 albums are core references.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦蓝调摇滚，1962 年至今。Jagger/Richards 写作；《Satisfaction》与 1968–72 专辑是主要参照。

body.en:
The Rolling Stones formed in London in 1962. Early sets mixed Chicago blues and R&B covers with original songs. (I Can’t Get No) Satisfaction (1965) made Richards’s fuzz riff a chart lead.

Beggars Banquet (1968), Let It Bleed (1969), Sticky Fingers (1971), and Exile on Main St. (1972) are the main late-60s/early-70s studio run. Open-G guitar parts, Watts’s pocket, and Jagger’s vocal delivery are the clearest identifiers across those records and later tours.
body.zh:
The Rolling Stones 于 1962 年在伦敦成立。早期曲目混合芝加哥蓝调、R&B 翻唱与原创歌。《(I Can’t Get No) Satisfaction》（1965）以 Richards 的 fuzz riff 打进排行榜前列。

《Beggars Banquet》（1968）、《Let It Bleed》（1969）、《Sticky Fingers》（1971）与《Exile on Main St.》（1972）是 60 末/70 初的主要录音室阶段。开放 G 调吉他声部、Watts 的口袋感与 Jagger 的演唱方式，是这些唱片及后来巡演中最易辨认的元素。

body.en:
Stones songs often start from a guitar riff, then add groove and vocal. Richards’s rhythm/lead parts and open-G tunings are central on many mid-period tracks.

Watts keeps a steady, swing-leaning pulse. Bass and second guitar change by era, but the Jagger–Richards–Watts core held for decades.
body.zh:
Stones 的歌曲常从吉他 riff 起笔，再叠 groove 与人声。Richards 的节奏/主音声部与开放 G 调，在许多中期作品里是核心。

Watts 维持稳定、偏摇摆的脉冲。贝斯与第二吉他随时期变化，但 Jagger–Richards–Watts 核心维持了数十年。

body.en:
Brian Jones played multi-instrument parts on early-to-mid-1960s records. Mick Taylor was on guitar for much of the late-60s/early-70s peak albums.

Ronnie Wood joined in the mid-1970s and remained for the long touring period. Charlie Watts stayed on drums until his death in 2021.
body.zh:
Brian Jones 在 1960 年代早中期唱片上负责多乐器声部。Mick Taylor 在 60 末/70 初多数高峰专辑中担任吉他。

Ronnie Wood 于 1970 年代中期加入，并留在长期巡演阶段。Charlie Watts 担任鼓手至 2021 年去世。

body.en:
Released in 1965. The main hook uses a Gibson Maestro FZ-1 fuzz on Richards’s guitar line. Jagger’s vocal is built around a repeating complaint lyric.

The single reached #1 in the US and UK and became one of the band’s earliest mass-radio identifiers.
body.zh:
1965 年发行。主钩子使用 Gibson Maestro FZ-1 fuzz 处理 Richards 的吉他线。Jagger 的人声围绕重复的抱怨式歌词。

单曲登上英美榜冠军，成为乐队最早的大众电台识别曲之一。

body.en:
Opening track on Let It Bleed (1969). Richards’s guitar riff leads; Merry Clayton sings the guest vocal part; Watts and Bill Wyman lock the rhythm section.

The arrangement stays in blues-rock form with stronger dynamic contrast than the mid-60s singles.
body.zh:
《Let It Bleed》（1969）开场曲。Richards 的吉他 riff 主导；Merry Clayton 唱客串人声；Watts 与 Bill Wyman 锁定节奏组。

编曲仍在蓝调摇滚形式内，动态对比强于 60 年代中期单曲。

title.en: Jagger, Richards, and the rhythm section

body.en:
Jagger and Richards write as the Glimmer Twins pairing. Watts’s drumming sits slightly behind or around the beat in a jazz-informed pocket.

Second guitar and bass roles change with Jones, Taylor, Wood, and other players; session takes document the balance more clearly than press labels.
body.zh:
Jagger 与 Richards 以 Glimmer Twins 搭档写作。Watts 的鼓点常略靠拍后或绕拍，带爵士影响的口袋感。

第二吉他与贝斯角色随 Jones、Taylor、Wood 等人变化；录音 take 比媒体标签更能说明声部平衡。

body.en:
Open-G riffs and Jagger’s phrasing appear in later hard rock and in garage/indie revival bands.

The 1968–72 albums remain the usual citation set; continuous touring kept the same catalog in active use for decades.
body.zh:
开放 G 调 riff 与 Jagger 的句式，出现在后来的 hard rock 以及车库/indie 复兴乐队中。

1968–72 专辑仍是常见引用集合；持续巡演使同一批曲目使用了数十年。

note.en: Long-running core with Watts on drums; Wood on second guitar from the mid-1970s.
note.zh: 以 Watts 司鼓的长期核心；Wood 自 1970 年代中期起任第二吉他。

note.en: Fuzz-riff single; US and UK #1 in 1965.
note.zh: Fuzz riff 单曲；1965 年英美榜冠军。

note.en: Blues-based riff writing sustained from 1960s singles through Exile-era albums and touring.
note.zh: 以蓝调为基础的 riff 写作，从 1960 年代单曲延续到 Exile 时期专辑与巡演。
